name: Champion
description:
Unique paint "Champion" can not be bought for any amount of money even on the Black Market. Made from gold and platinum fibers, it is given strictly under personal signature only to the winners of big team tournaments.
See also: Paints
interestingFacts: Players who receive this paint will also receive a unique Spectrum A module with  30% protection against all turrets and mines.
For the first time, paint was issued to the winners of MCH-3 and had the protection of 15% from all turrets.
After MCH-4, the protection of the Champion paint is 20% of all turrets
After June 18, 2013 (update 163), the Champion paint protected - 22% of all turrets.
Since November 21, 2013 (update 193), the Champion paint protected - 25% of all turrets.
Clan General Tanks won the right to own the paint 3 times, and clan Arcade (in the past NooBest) - 4 times.
With the release of new protective paints on January 29 and February 6, 2015, the paint acquired protection from the Hammer, Vulcan, and mines.
With the transition of e-sports competitions to StarLadder, the paint began to stand out for 1st place in the Star Series.
On January 11, 2016, paint was removed from garages from the latest Star Series winners - the ALL IN clan.
On June 4, 2016, the paint was given to the winners of the Masters of the Sword tournament - the Arm Power clan.
On July 14, 2016, the paint lost its protections due to the separation of paints into textures and protective modules.
On December 24, 2016, paint was issued to the winners of the Inter-Clan Championship 9 tournament - the Synergy clan.
On November 27, 2017, the paint was given to the winners of the Interclan Championship X tournament - the Synergy clan.
On November 26, 2018, paint was issued to the winners of the XI Clan Championship tournament - the Eternity Advanced clan.
On November 26, 2019, paint was issued to the winners of the XII Clan Championship tournament - the Penguins clan.
On November 27, 2020, paint was issued to the winners of the XIII Clan Championship tournament - the Revenge clan.
After April 23, 2021 (update 644), the Champion paint received an updated Spectrum A module that protected - 30% of all turrets and mines.
At the moment, Champion can be earned by placing first in one of the Major eSports Tournaments.
